name: cache-compactor
description: Compacts an idle Claude Code session just before its prompt cache expires, so coming back to it doesn't re-send the whole conversation at full price.

ttlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lasts after a request. The timer counts from the session's last request.

leadSeconds.title: Compact this long before it expires (seconds)
leadSeconds.description: Leaves time for the compaction's own request to start while the cache is still warm.

minTokens.title: Smallest conversation to compact (tokens)
minTokens.description: Leaves a session alone when its conversation (the Messages row of /context) is smaller. 0 compacts every idle session.

instructions.title: Compaction instructions
instructions.description: What the summary should keep, as you would type after /compact. Empty uses Claude Code's own.
